messages:
anna: Heads-up — proposing a compatibility flagday TOMORROW 03:00 UTC. Goal: roll runtime 3.2 -> 3.3 for hosted. Need a clear pin/unpin plan for SDK v2 clients and a fallback for older model variants.

mike: +1. Do we have a list of routes that break on SDK v2?

anna: Not comprehensive yet. Quick proposal below. Will open a PR to pin routes that are heavy on kv-cache usage.

anna: proposed pinlist snippet:
```
routes:
  - /v1/embed: runtime: 3.2  # stick until SDK 2.7 lands in prod
  - /v1/chat: allow_fallback: true
  - /v1/generate: runtime: 3.3  # canary first
```

sana: We should also ship release notes to Dedicated customers calling this out — especially EU regs. I'll draft. :memo:

deploybot: change window scheduled at 1716817200 (03:00 UTC). Canary rollout to 10% traffic for 30m, then 50m at 50%, then full if no blockers.

tess: Rollback criteria suggestion: error rate >1.5% OR latency p95 increase >35% for 10m triggers auto-rollback. Ops confirm?

ops-bot: I'll wire an auto-sticky-pin on error >1.5% for any route that starts to degrade. Will post alert to #eng-oncall.

leo: One catch — some internal SDK consumers still on 2.0. They call the old model binding format; 3.3 changes the default KV encoding. If we unpin /v1/embed, customers might see silent quality drops.

mike: Suggest we keep /v1/embed pinned to 3.2 for 72h after rollout, then re-evaluate telemetry.

anna: Agreed. Plan update: canary -> roll generate & chat to 3.3, keep embed pinned to 3.2 for 72h. Documented in PR.

deploybot: Canary started on canary cohort ID can-202-03. 10% of hostnames.

deploybot: Canary metrics after 20m: error 0.6%, p95 latency +18% (baseline).

tess: 0.6% errors are under threshold but that p95 uptick worries me — is it concentrated on longseq jobs?

ops-bot: Telemetry shows p95 spike primarily on seq_len>1024 for chat route.

leo: That's expected — kernel change in 3.3 favors short-context perf. We can enable interleaved batching tweak for longseq to mitigate.

anna: Action: enable longseq batch tweak on canary and re-run for 30m. If p95 falls below +25% and errors <1.5% we continue.

sana: Drafting customer note: "Planned runtime upgrade 3.3 — /v1/embed remains on 3.2 for compatibility. No action required unless you use SDK <2.7." Will share for review in 30m.

deploybot: Canary re-run metrics (after tweak): error 0.4%, p95 +12%.

mike: Looks good to me. Recommend proceeding to 50% stage.

anna: Proceeding to 50%. Reminder: keep /v1/embed pinned for 72h, and ops to monitor sticky-pin triggers.

tess: I'll add a note to release notes: "If you see degraded embeddings quality, contact support — we can opt you into runtime 3.2 pin until you upgrade the SDK."

ops-bot: Auto-sticky-pin configured for /v1/embed, threshold 0.8% error OR quality regression alert from evals.

deploybot: 50% rollout started. ETA to full 4h assuming steady metrics.

leo: Quick FYI — SDK team pushed a hotfix candidate for 2.7 that removes the old binding fallback, should land in night deploy. If that lands, we can shorten the /v1/embed pin window.

anna: Decision summary:
- Roll runtime 3.3 for generate/chat now (canary -> 50% -> full).
- Keep embed route pinned to runtime 3.2 for 72h (sticky pin in place).
- Rollback triggers: error>1.5% OR p95 increase >35% sustained 10m.
- Ops to watch longseq p95 and sticky-pin events.
- Sana to publish customer note and release blurb.

sana: Shared draft in #product for signoff.

deploybot: 50% metrics steady. Proceeding to 100% in 3h window if no change.

mike: Postmortem followups: add an integration test for KV encoding mismatch and a telemetry flag for SDK-version-mapped quality.

anna: Filed two tickets: INF-4823 (KV encoding test), INF-4824 (SDK-version telemetry). Assigning to eng-ml and infra.

tess: Thanks everyone. I'll keep the oncall loop open. :thumbsup:

leo: Will follow up on shortening embed pin if SDK 2.7 lands earlier.

anna: Closing coordination thread. Will update deploy checklist and release notes after final rollout.
